SELECT A.REG_CODE as prdRegistCode, A.ACCOUNT as prodId, NVL(A.AGENCY_CODE,A.REGIST_BANK_CODE) as institutionCode, A.FUND_ACC_PLACE as areaCode, B.HOLDER_TYPE as holderType, A.CCY as ccy, A.PROD_VALUE as prodValue, A.IS_CONSIGN as isagency, sum(A.saleAmount) as daySaleAmountSum, sum(A.valueAmount) as dayValueAmountSum, sum(A.saleTotalByQty) as daySaleQtySum, sum(A.valueTotalByQty) as dayValueQtySum, sum(A.saleTotalByQty) * A.PROD_VALUE as saleTotalByQty, sum(A.valueTotalByQty) * A.PROD_VALUE as valueTotalByQty, to_date(#{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') as equityConfDate FROM ( SELECT REG_CODE, ACCOUNT, FUND_ACC_PLACE, IS_CONSIGN, PROD_VALUE, ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK, REGIST_BANK_CODE, EQUITY_CONF_DATE, AGENCY_CODE, CCY,
case when BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14') THEN AMOUNT ELSE 0 END AS saleAmount,
case when BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14') THEN AMOUNT when BUSI_TYPE in ('03','16','15') THEN AMOUNT * -1 ELSE 0 END AS valueAmount,
case when BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14') THEN SHARES ELSE 0 END AS saleTotalByQty,
case when BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14') THEN SHARES when BUSI_TYPE in ('03','16','15') THEN SHARES * -1 ELSE 0 END AS valueTotalByQty FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE STATUS != '03' and TO_CHAR(EQUITY_CONF_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT(INDENTIFY_MARK), ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK, REGIST_BANK_CODE, HOLDER_TYPE FROM( select INDENTIFY_MARK, ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK, REGIST_BANK_CODE, HOLDER_TYPE from (SELECT STATUS, INDENTIFY_MARK, ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK, REGIST_BANK_CODE, CASE HOLDER_CLASSIFY when '01' THEN decode(HOLDER_TYPE,'01','02','02','02','03','02','04','03','05','04','06','05','07','06','08','07','09','08','10','09','11','99','12','99','13','99','14','99','15','99','16','99','17','10', '18','10','19','10','20','10','21','10','22','10','23','10','24','99','25','99','99') when '02' THEN decode(HOLDER_TYPE,'01','01','02','01','03','01','04','03','05','04','06','05','07','06','08','07','09','08','10','09','11','99','12','99','13','99','14','99','15','99','16','99','17','10', '18','10','19','10','20','10','21','10','22','10','23','10','24','99','25','99','99') END as HOLDER_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by INDENTIFY_MARK order by UPDATE_TIME desc ) indMarkNo FROM CHB_EQU_SUB ) where indMarkNo = 1 and STATUS != '03'
union ALL
SELECT INDENTIFY_MARK, ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK, REGIST_BANK_CODE, CASE HOLDER_CLASSIFY when '01' THEN decode(HOLDER_TYPE,'01','02','02','02','03','02','04','03','05','04','06','05','07','06','08','07','09','08','10','09','11','99','12','99','13','99','14','99','15','99','16','99','17','10', '18','10','19','10','20','10','21','10','22','10','23','10','24','99','25','99','99') when '02' THEN decode(HOLDER_TYPE,'01','01','02','01','03','01','04','03','05','04','06','05','07','06','08','07','09','08','10','09','11','99','12','99','13','99','14','99','15','99','16','99','17','10', '18','10','19','10','20','10','21','10','22','10','23','10','24','99','25','99','99') END as HOLDER_TYPE FROM CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK ) ) B on A.ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK GROUP BY A.REG_CODE, A.ACCOUNT, NVL(A.AGENCY_CODE,A.REGIST_BANK_CODE), A.FUND_ACC_PLACE, B.HOLDER_TYPE, A.CCY, A.PROD_VALUE, A.IS_CONSIGN
SELECT COUNT(*) from CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE TO_CHAR(EQUITY_CONF_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
